name: @aritra0/figma-mcp-connect
stderr:
Usage: figma-mcp-connect [options] [command]

Connect Figma MCP to common AI developer tools.

Options:
  -V, --version              output the version number
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Commands:
  setup [options]            Configure Figma MCP for AI tools.
  server [options]           Run the local PAT-backed Figma MCP server.
  doctor [options]           Check token and MCP config state.
  oauth [options]            Open and verify official Figma MCP OAuth for a
                             supported client.
  list                       List known Figma MCP config entries.
  remove [options] <client>  Remove figma and figma-pat MCP entries for one
                             client.
  where                      Show config locations used by supported clients.
  help [command]             display help for command
